records.source: The chaining strip: where a module says what it will read, and what is stale.

records.context: The strip sits directly above the processing session button of a workflow screen and shows three things:
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The strip sits directly above the Run button of a pipeline screen and shows three things:
records.translation: 该信息条直接位于流程界面的 Run 按钮上方，显示三项内容：

records.context: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the laboratory microplate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the microscope field of view;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the plate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the field;
records.translation: **它将读取什么。** :mod:`spacr.chaining` 向产物注册表查询上一个模块实际写入的位置，并用它填充本模块的源文件夹，因此在 Mask 之后打开的 Measure 已经填好了板文件夹。用户自己输入的路径会被 *固定*，绝不会被覆盖 — 当上游之后发生移动时，新位置会以一个按钮的形式显示在固定路径旁边，而绝不会被强行写入该字段；

records.context: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on application view *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on screen *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.translation: **哪些内容已过时。** :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` 将注册表的原因代码转换为一句说明和一个修复方法，因此 "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone"（这些测量值来自一次你之后已重做的 Mask 运行）会在打开图形 *之前* 就显示在屏幕上，而不是事后才发现；

records.context: **what comes next.**  A finished processing session offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what comes next.**  A finished run offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.translation: **接下来是什么。** 一次完成的运行会根据 :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules` 提供其后续模块，每个都预先填入刚刚产生的产物，并且都经过 :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` 检查 — 因此提供的选项要么可用，要么以灰显形式显示并附上无法使用的原因。

records.context: Installation goes through the two seams that already exist rather than through the shared application view: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES` (consulted by ``MainWindow._build_screen`` before its built-in chain) and :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`, which imports this module after ``app.py`` is loaded and before the first window is built.  ``AppScreen`` itself is untouched.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Installation goes through the two seams that already exist rather than through the shared screen: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES` (consulted by ``MainWindow._build_screen`` before its built-in chain) and :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`, which imports this module after ``app.py`` is loaded and before the first window is built.  ``AppScreen`` itself is untouched.
records.translation: 安装通过两个已有的接口完成，而不是通过共享界面：:data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES`（``MainWindow._build_screen`` 在其内置链之前会查询它）以及 :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`，后者会在 ``app.py`` 加载之后、第一个窗口构建之前导入本模块。``AppScreen`` 本身保持不变。

records.context: :func:`register` is the whole of the installation and is idempotent, so a build whose launch list has not yet learned about this module can call it from anywhere that executes before the first window.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`register` is the whole of the installation and is idempotent, so a build whose launch list has not yet learned about this module can call it from anywhere that runs before the first window.
records.translation: :func:`register` 就是全部的安装步骤，并且是幂等的，因此即使某个构建的启动列表尚未包含本模块，也可以在第一个窗口之前运行的任何位置调用它。

records.source: Design:
records.translation: 设计：

records.context: A drop is delivered by Qt on the main GUI execution path and every path in it is a path the USER chose -- which may sit on a sleeping ``autofs`` share that takes more than twenty seconds to answer one stat (see :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`). So the drop is split in two, and the seam is the rule for anything added here:

records.source: The application historically embedded English text directly in its widgets. Replacing every call site at once would make localization brittle, so this module provides two complementary layers:
records.translation: 该应用程序过去直接在部件中嵌入英文文本。一次性替换所有调用处会让本地化变得脆弱，因此本模块提供两个互补的层次：

records.context: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` safely updates already-created static Qt labels, buttons, menus, tabs, combo-box choices and accessibility text. Original English strings are retained as dynamic Qt properties, allowing a window to switch from Swedish to Korean (for example) without translating a translation. Editable values and user-entered paths are never touched.
records.label: spacr.qt.i18n#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` safely updates already-created static Qt labels, buttons, menus, tabs, combo-box choices and accessibility text. Original English strings are retained as dynamic Qt properties, allowing a window to switch from Swedish to Korean (for example) without translating a translation. records.context: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that executes in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that runs in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.translation: ROI 功能分布在两个模块中。:mod:`spacr.roi` 是在测量工作进程中运行的那一半 — 几何计算、保留/丢弃规则，以及把两者送入 ``spawn`` 进程池的环境路径。本模块是需要鼠标的那一半：一支把点击转换为 :class:`spacr.layers.Shape` 的画笔，以及一个把形状图层转换为 :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` 并开启测量过滤器的面板。

records.source: The pen draws into the model, not onto the widget
records.translation: 画笔绘制到模型中，而不是绘制到部件上

records.context: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.translation: 每个顶点都是取自 :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at` 的世界坐标，正在绘制的多边形是一个真实的 :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape`，位于真实的 :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer` 中。因此未完成的 ROI 由与其他一切相同的合成器渲染，缩放后依然保留，而完成的 ROI 已经是 :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` 可读取的形式。绘制过程中没有任何内容以像素为单位，正因如此，在降采样预览上绘制的 ROI 才能在全分辨率掩膜上指向同一区域。

records.context: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.
records.translation: 只有在必要时才改变展示级别，而且这一改变不会被记住。无条件切换到 All 也能奏效，但同时每当有人跳转到这里，就会改写该模块所记住的 Essentials/All 选择 -- 这是用户自己选择的设置，却因为查找某样东西的副作用而被改变。因此会先清除过滤条件，只有在此之后该行仍不在表单上时才提升级别，而这恰恰是 Essentials 将其隐藏的情况；并且提升通过 :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering` 进行，因此表单会显示该行，而存储中仍保留用户选定的级别。大多数设置都不属于 Essentials，因此如果查找会持久保存这次提升，几乎每个模块都会永久脱离 Essentials。

records.context: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- the process-wide ``RunRegistry`` that ``make_thread`` adds every job to. Not an ad-hoc "busy" flag each caller has to remember to set and, more importantly, remember to clear: the registry is the same state every application view's ``active_jobs()`` is counting, and it is maintained by ``make_thread`` itself, so a job that forgets to tell anyone it started still turns the spinner on.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- the process-wide ``RunRegistry`` that ``make_thread`` adds every job to. Not an ad-hoc "busy" flag each caller has to remember to set and, more importantly, remember to clear: the registry is the same state every screen's ``active_jobs()`` is counting, and it is maintained by ``make_thread`` itself, so a job that forgets to tell anyone it started still turns the spinner on.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- 即进程级的 ``RunRegistry``，``make_thread`` 会把每个任务都加入其中。它不是每个调用方都得记得设置、而且更重要的是还得记得清除的临时 "busy"（忙碌）标志：该注册表就是每个界面的 ``active_jobs()`` 所统计的同一份状态，并且由 ``make_thread`` 自己维护，因此即使某个任务忘了告诉任何人它已开始，也仍会让旋转指示器启动。

records.context: Not immediately. Most of what goes through ``make_thread`` -- reading a measurement table, listing a plate, loading a settings file -- is finished inside a second, and an indicator that appears and vanishes in that time would only flicker.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Not immediately. Most of what goes through ``make_thread`` -- reading a measurement table, listing a plate, loading a settings file -- is finished inside a second, and an indicator that appears and vanishes in that time would only flicker.
records.translation: 不会立即出现。经过 ``make_thread`` 的大多数工作 -- 读取测量表、列出板的内容、加载设置文件 -- 都在一秒内完成，而在这段时间内出现又消失的指示器只会造成闪烁。

records.context: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on application view -- no duration is estimated.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on screen -- no duration is estimated.
records.translation: 因此，部件会先等待 :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` 秒（默认 2）再显示。其机制是 **延迟，而不是预测**：:meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` 在工作开始的那一刻启动一个单次计时器，只有当计时器触发时 :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` *仍然* 为真，旋转指示器才会显示。在 1.9 s 时完成的任务会在结束时取消计时器，屏幕上永远不会出现任何东西 -- 不会估算任何持续时间。

records.context: The clock executes on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#15
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The clock runs on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.
records.translation: 计时针对的是 *工作*，而不是单个任务。在计时器等待期间启动的第二个任务不会重新启动计时器：计时器只在从空闲变为忙碌的那一刻启动，因此持续两秒的连续后台活动会显示旋转指示器，即使没有任何单个任务持续那么久。变为空闲会解除计时器，下一轮工作会重新开始计算两秒。

records.context: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` is the asset this widget was asked to reuse, and it is not reused, for three measured reasons:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` is the asset this widget was asked to reuse, and it is not reused, for three measured reasons:
records.translation: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` 是此部件原本被要求复用的资源，但出于三个经过测量的原因，它没有被复用：

records.context: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.translation: **尺寸。** 800x600，144 帧，磁盘上占 682 KB。``QMovie`` 会把每一帧解码为 32 位 ``QImage``，因此一帧为 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB，整个循环为 276 MB。``QMovie.CacheAll`` 会全部保存；``CacheNone``（默认值）则以每秒 33 次、永不停止地重新解码 1.92 MB 并将其缩放到 16 px 为代价换取内存。

records.context: **Transparency.** Every pixel of every frame has alpha 255 and the background is ``#000000``. The GIF is not a sprite, it is a *video of* a spinner. Dropped beside "Clear console" it paints an opaque black square, which is invisible in the dark theme and a hole in the light one.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#4

records.source: **Transparency.** Every pixel of every frame has alpha 255 and the background is ``#000000``. The GIF is not a sprite, it is a *video of* a spinner. Dropped beside "Clear console" it paints an opaque black square, which is invisible in the dark theme and a hole in the light one.
records.translation: **透明度。** 每一帧的每个像素 alpha 均为 255，背景为 ``#000000``。这个 GIF 不是精灵图，而是一段旋转指示器的 *视频*。放在 "Clear console" 旁边时，它会画出一个不透明的黑色方块，在深色主题中看不见，在浅色主题中则像一个洞。

records.context: **Legibility.** The motif is a 1-2 px white stroke on an 800 px canvas. Scaled to 16 px that stroke is 0.02 px wide: it does not survive, with or without smooth transformation.

records.source: **Legibility.** The motif is a 1-2 px white stroke on an 800 px canvas. Scaled to 16 px that stroke is 0.02 px wide: it does not survive, with or without smooth transformation.

records.context: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.translation: 把各帧预先缩放一次并保存为 ``QPixmap`` 对象，可以解决每帧开销问题，但解决不了另外两个问题，而且为了一个 16 px 的小点，启动时仍要花费 276 MB 的解码。因此改为重新绘制该图案：这个 GIF 的 *特征* 是一个细环，以及环绕它移动的双螺旋编织带（参见各帧 -- 编织带转动，环保持不动），而这正是 :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` 用两个 ``QPolygonF`` 对象绘制的内容。它只需几微秒，颜色取自实时调色板，因此在浅色和深色主题下都能适配，并且在任何尺寸下都很清晰。

records.translation: 抽屉是一种 *显现* 机制：沿左边缘有一条 6 px 宽的条带，当指针停留在其上时，整个面板会滑入并覆盖在页面之上，指针离开时再滑出。主窗口会让其抽屉保持关闭和禁用，并将应用列表显示为停靠栏列，或将其隐藏（参见 :meth:`spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.apply_dock_mode`）。

records.context: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.translation: 有三点决定了显现机制是让人感觉有意为之，还是会在你瞄准别处时误触发：

records.context: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.translation: **停留，而不是触碰。** 进入条带会启动 :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`；只是在去别处途中经过条带的指针，会在计时器触发前就已离开。

records.context: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.translation: **宽松的关闭。** 离开 *不会* 立即关闭 — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` 覆盖了面板与指针晃到的任何位置之间的空隙，任何重新进入都会取消关闭。指针一偏离就立即合上的面板在触控板上根本无法使用。

records.context: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.translation: **固定。** 在抽屉打开时点击任意一行，否则会与关闭动画发生竞争。:meth:`hold` 会让抽屉保持打开，直到有东西明确释放它，键盘路径也是这样工作的。

records.context: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. The window installs a shortcut for this — a reveal you can only reach by hovering is a reveal a keyboard user cannot reach at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. records.translation: **它不仅限于鼠标。** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` 会打开抽屉、将其固定，并让第一行获得焦点；按 Escape（或焦点离开面板）会再次关闭它。窗口为此安装了一个快捷键 — 只能通过悬停才能触发的显现机制，对键盘用户来说根本无法触及。

records.translation: 抽屉初始时完全位于屏幕之外，而不是被隐藏：隐藏的部件不报告几何信息，而教程覆盖层需要一个可以指向的矩形。是否打开作为单独的标志记录，而不是根据位置推断 -- 滑动需要 170 ms，在这 170 ms 内，根据位置推断的结果会把正在打开的抽屉判定为关闭，调用方就是这样与动画发生竞争的。

records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_dictionary.FeatureHelpFilter.eventFilter#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: 先读取事件类型，再进行存活检查。此过滤器安装在 QApplication 上，因此过去两次 `_still_alive` 调用会针对进程中的每个事件运行 -- 一次打开 Regression 期间就有 94,431 个事件，性能剖析显示一次打开 Mask 时这对调用共执行了 839,906 次。读取一个 C++ 那一半已不存在的对象的类型会引发异常，而下面的 `except` 本来就会以同样的 `False` 处理，因此这种顺序没有任何代价，现在这些检查只会针对上下文菜单运行。

records.translation: 冷启动时，第一次点击需要 360 ms 的 CSV 读取 -- 五张随附注释表、DeepTMHMM 的 8,140 行，以及 :mod:`spacr.gene_tile` 保存的 gRNA 参考和元数据索引 -- 这会在鼠标按下时冻结图表。

records.context: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a background execution unit, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the execution concurrency rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a main GUI execution path object, never a closure, so the handler executes on the main GUI execution path and the QThread is retired. Given the application view's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a key-value mapping lookup.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a worker thread, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the threading rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a GUI-thread object, never a closure, so the handler runs on the GUI thread and the QThread is retired. Given the screen's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a dictionary lookup.
records.translation: 因此 :func:`warm_annotation` 在工作线程上通过 :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` 完成所有这些工作，该模块已经正确处理了线程规则：工作线程的 ``finished`` 通过一个 Signal 转发，其接收者是某个 GUI 线程对象的绑定方法，而绝不是闭包，因此处理函数在 GUI 线程上运行，QThread 也会被回收。给定界面自身的基因条目，它会在一次连接中预热所有基因 -- 400 个基因与一个基因同样只需 21 ms -- 此后一次点击只是一次字典查找。

The thread's lifetime is guarded twice, because Qt aborts the process if a running ``QThread`` is destroyed and a panel can be dropped without ever being closed -- a tab rebuilt, a screen replaced, an interpreter shutting down.
records.translation: 注释查找在工作线程上预热，而且只在面板真正显示之后才进行：否则，每次移动筛选条件都用同一张表重新设置的面板，会在没有任何新基因的情况下每次重绘都启动一个线程。线程的生命周期受到双重保护，因为一旦运行中的 ``QThread`` 被销毁，Qt 就会中止进程，而面板可能在从未被关闭的情况下就被丢弃 -- 例如选项卡被重建、界面被替换、解释器正在关闭。

records.context: Three things can start the warm-up -- the first show, `warm_now`, and a frame arriving -- so this guards the panel's lifetime rather than each start site: whenever the panel is collected, with or without a close, with or without an event loop, the thread is asked to stop first.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things can start the warm-up -- the first show, `warm_now`, and a frame arriving -- so this guards the panel's lifetime rather than each start site: whenever the panel is collected, with or without a close, with or without an event loop, the thread is asked to stop first.
records.translation: 有三种情况会启动预热 -- 首次显示、`warm_now` 以及数据框到达 -- 因此这里保护的是面板的生命周期，而不是每一个启动点：无论面板何时被回收，无论是否关闭、是否有事件循环，都会先请求线程停止。

records.context: The other two guards each need an event to fire. `closeEvent` needs somebody to close the panel; `QApplication.aboutToQuit` needs an event loop to quit. A panel built, handed a table and dropped -- a tab rebuilt, an application view replaced, a headless script, a test -- reaches neither, and Qt calls `abort()` on the running independent execution path. That was SIGABRT on `QApplication([]); RegressionResultsPanel()`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel.GenePanel.__del__#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The other two guards each need an event to fire. `closeEvent` needs somebody to close the panel; `QApplication.aboutToQuit` needs an event loop to quit. A panel built, handed a table and dropped -- a tab rebuilt, a screen replaced, a headless script, a test -- reaches neither, and Qt calls `abort()` on the running thread. That was SIGABRT on `QApplication([]); RegressionResultsPanel()`.
records.translation: 另外两种保护都需要触发某个事件。`closeEvent` 需要有人关闭面板；`QApplication.aboutToQuit` 需要有事件循环退出。一个被构建、交给一张表、然后被丢弃的面板 -- 选项卡被重建、界面被替换、无界面脚本、测试 -- 两者都不会触发，于是 Qt 会对运行中的线程调用 `abort()`。这就是 `QApplication([]); RegressionResultsPanel()` 上出现的 SIGABRT。

records.context: Everything here is swallowed on purpose. `__del__` runs during garbage collection and at interpreter shutdown, where the C++ half may already be gone and the module globals may already be None; an exception thrown here is printed and ignored by Python anyway, and the one thing worth doing is the shutdown attempt.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel.GenePanel.__del__#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything here is swallowed on purpose. `__del__` runs during garbage collection and at interpreter shutdown, where the C++ half may already be gone and the module globals may already be None; an exception raised here is printed and ignored by Python anyway, and the one thing worth doing is the shutdown attempt.
records.translation: 这里的一切异常都有意被吞掉。`__del__` 在垃圾回收期间以及解释器关闭时运行，此时 C++ 那一半可能已经不存在，模块全局变量也可能已是 None；这里引发的异常无论如何都会被 Python 打印后忽略，而唯一值得做的就是尝试关闭线程。

records.context: That reveal is per setting. Pressing **Animation** on ``cell_diameter`` shows ``cell_diameter``'s animation and nothing else; move to the next setting and it is hidden again until its own **Animation** is pressed. A session-wide reveal was the obvious alternative and is exactly wrong for the machines this was asked for: one click would put every later hover back on the ~73 ms decode path for the rest of the processing session, which is the cost the change exists to avoid. Measured, the same sweep of 141 settings taken straight after a press: still 0 decodes.

Measured, the same sweep of 141 settings taken straight after a press: still 0 decodes.
records.translation: 这种显示是 PER SETTING（按设置分别）进行的。在 ``cell_diameter`` 上按下 **Animation** 只会显示 ``cell_diameter`` 的动画；移到下一个设置时，动画会再次隐藏，直到按下该设置自己的 **Animation**。会话范围的显示是显而易见的替代方案，但对于提出此需求的机器来说恰恰是错误的：一次点击就会让之后的每次悬停在剩余运行期间都回到约 ~73 ms 的解码路径上，而这正是此项改动要避免的开销。实测在按下后立即对同样的 141 个设置进行遍历：仍为 0 次解码。

Because a press only ever names one setting, it can never leave the preference unable to take effect.
records.translation: *Setting animations* 偏好是为希望始终显示动画的读者准备的退路：开启时，每个工具提示一开始就显示动画，而该词会折叠 THIS（当前这个）动画；关闭时 — 即默认值 — 每个工具提示一开始都隐藏动画，而该词会显示 THIS（当前这个）动画。由于一次按下只会指定一个设置，它永远不会使该偏好无法生效。

records.translation: 显示哪个动画由锚点的 ``settingKey`` 属性决定，因此调用方无需传入；在标签上放置帮助的调用方已经设置了该属性。任何没有该属性的对象 — 分区标题、主页磁贴 — 都会得到只有文字的弹出窗口，没有可点击的 **Animation** 一词。

records.translation: 当鼠标进入弹出窗口时，它会取消自己的隐藏计时器，只有当锚点和弹出窗口本身都不在光标下时才会真正隐藏。

records.context: Only one tooltip ever appears. The application views that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for application view readers.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hover_tooltip#20
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Only one tooltip ever appears. The screens that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for screen readers.
records.translation: 任何时候都只会出现一个工具提示。为此弹出窗口提供锚点的界面也会在同一标签上保留一个原生 Qt 工具提示（``refresh_api_tooltips`` 会在每次 ``Enter`` 时为无障碍树重新应用它），而 Qt 自身的工具提示计时器会在一秒后把它弹出，叠在本弹出窗口之上 — 一前一后两个工具提示。因此，占用一个锚点时会在其上安装 :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor`，它会吞掉 ``QEvent.ToolTip``，同时为屏幕阅读器保留完整的 ``toolTip()``。

records.context: It lays out as well as data-selection filtering. The panel builds a slot's controls when the count reaches it rather than building all 702 up front, so a count that rises while this dialog is open arrives as controls with no rows; `_adopt_new_slot_controls` puts them in the block before the data-selection boundary below decides which are shown.

records.source: IT LAYS OUT AS WELL AS GATING. records.translation: IT LAYS OUT AS WELL AS GATING（它既负责布局也负责显示门控）。面板在数量达到某个槽位时才构建该槽位的控件，而不是一开始就构建全部 702 个，因此在此对话框打开期间增加的数量，会以没有行的控件形式到达；`_adopt_new_slot_controls` 会先把它们放进区块，然后由下面的门控决定显示哪些。

records.source: Dispatches: the crop pass runs on a worker and the grid is rebuilt when it lands. Every knob in the Crop settings dialog is wired to this, so it used to freeze the window for 1441 ms per spinbox step on a 1024x1024x8 array. Re-cropping supersedes by token, so dragging a spinbox through ten values draws the last one rather than all ten.

records.context: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the microplate sample positions that carry them, which the user can change. records.source: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the wells that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", the derived wells are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.translation: 面板打开时已选中排名靠前的命中：最显著的若干向导序列或基因，以及携带它们的孔，用户可以更改这些选择。回归的结果表给出这些命中（:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`）；若没有结果表，则以拼图自身各组的向导序列作为选择。随后群体选择框初始为 "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells"（所选孔中的向导序列及其他数据点），推导出的孔显示在控件下方，"gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" 可分别更改两者。若没有可选的内容，则初始为 "All datapoints"（所有数据点），因此没有向导序列的面板仍会绘制它以前绘制的内容。

records.context: Colour: every colour painted here is derived from the theme that is on application view, never written as a literal, and the derivation preserves the relative luminance of the theme's own accent role. Contrast is a function of relative luminance and of nothing else, so a colour made this way clears exactly the contrast that the accent already clears on that theme, including the themes whose panels are translucent over a photograph. That is what lets an arbitrary number of barcode types each get a colour of their own without any of them becoming unreadable on any theme.

records.context: What it guarantees. Reads are drawn in a fixed pitch face at fixed character positions, so column forty of one read sits above column forty of the next. A barcode type keeps one colour for as long as the view is showing it, so the eye can follow a match down the rows, and a legend above the reads says which colour is which.
records.translation: 它所保证的内容。读段以等宽字体在固定的字符位置上绘制，因此一条读段的第四十列正好位于下一条读段第四十列的上方。一条读段绝不会换到第二个可视行上：过长的读段会让视图横向滚动，因为换行的读段会破坏每行一条读段的布局。只要视图在显示某种条形码类型，它就保持同一种颜色，使眼睛能够沿着各行追踪一个匹配，而读段上方的图例会说明每种颜色代表什么。

records.context: What it costs. Setting ten thousand reads and showing the view resolves the character ownership of a screenful of rows, not of ten thousand, which is what keeps the interface responsive on a real FASTQ sample rather than on a toy one.

records.translation: UNDER ``spaceout`` THE RIM OSCILLATES IN EVERY MODE（在该装饰下，边缘在每种模式中都会振荡）。跟随指针的标记是卡片上唯一本来就在移动的东西，而在一个以移动光谱为全部要点的主题下让它保持固定的蓝色，正是这项需求所要解决的问题。其色调是调色板自身的漂移加上一个快得多的自有循环（:data:`SPACEOUT_RIM_PERIOD`），因此它属于窗口其余部分正在经历的同一光谱，而不是第二道毫不相关的彩虹。

records.context: The ray from the centre, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.

records.source: THE RAY FROM THE CENTRE, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.
records.translation: THE RAY FROM THE CENTRE（从中心出发的射线），而不是最近的边。把一个点投影到恰好最近的那条边上，在对角线处是不连续的：指针一越过对角线，目标就从上边的中点跳到左边的中点，这正是被报告为指针在卡片内部时边缘与指针不同步的现象。从中心经过指针的射线离开矩形的那个点是连续移动的，而且始终是边缘上真正位于指针方向的位置 -- 如果鼠标可以位于任何地方，"flows towards the mouse"（流向鼠标）就必须是这个意思。

records.translation: 因为它是一条 RAY（射线），所以无需钳制，对卡片外部的指针也能像对内部的指针一样给出答案。

records.context: The rim is treated as a rectangle, not as the rounded path it is drawn on. The corner arcs are a few pixels of a perimeter hundreds long, and paying for exact arc length here would buy an accuracy no eye can see on a value that is chasing a mouse anyway.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card.SetupCard.perimeter_position#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: THE RIM IS TREATED AS A RECTANGLE, not as the rounded path it is drawn on. The corner arcs are a few pixels of a perimeter hundreds long, and paying for exact arc length here would buy an accuracy no eye can see on a value that is chasing a mouse anyway.
records.translation: THE RIM IS TREATED AS A RECTANGLE（边缘被视为矩形），而不是其实际绘制所沿的圆角路径。圆角弧在数百像素长的周长中只占几个像素，为精确弧长付出代价，换来的只是在一个本来就在追逐鼠标的值上任何肉眼都看不出的精度。

records.context: ``TrackStats`` can tell you that a field produced 41 tracks with a median length of 6 frames in a 30-frame series. records.source: ``TrackStats`` can tell you that a field produced 41 tracks with a median length of 6 frames in a 30-frame series. It cannot tell you *why*, and the cause decides which setting to change: two cells that touch for three frames and come apart with their identities swapped needs a different setting from one cell that leaves the field and comes back.
records.translation: ``TrackStats`` 可以告诉你，在一个 30 帧的序列中某个视野产生了 41 条轨迹，中位长度为 6 帧。它无法告诉你 *原因*，而原因决定了应更改哪个设置：两个细胞接触三帧后分开、身份互换，与一个细胞离开视野后又回来，需要调整的是不同的设置。

records.context: So this shows the frames. One field plays as a movie; clicking it opens a filmstrip above, which is the same frames laid out at once and scrollable, because a break is easiest to find by scrubbing and easiest to *understand* by seeing the frames either side of it together.

records.translation: 因此这里会显示各帧。一个视野以影片形式播放；点击它会在上方打开一条胶片条，即把同样的帧一次性排开并可滚动，因为中断最容易通过拖动浏览来发现，而最容易通过同时查看中断前后的帧来 *理解*。

records.context: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.

records.source: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.
records.translation: 所有内容都复用 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` 中已有的渲染 -- ``render_frame`` 按轨迹 id 为掩膜轮廓着色并绘制拖尾折线，而 ``track_colour`` 是确定性的，因此颜色就标识了一条轨迹：保持其轨迹 id 的对象在每一帧和每张缩略图中都保持相同颜色，于是身份互换会表现为一个在胶片条中途改变颜色的对象。

records.context: Three design rules:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three design rules:
records.translation: 三条设计原则：

records.context: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless workflow calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on application view, at full vector quality.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless pipeline calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on screen, at full vector quality.
records.translation: **只有一个渲染器。** 每个像素都来自 :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`，即无界面流程所调用的同一个函数。导出时会以打印尺寸、根据同一个 :class:`VolcanoStyle` 重新渲染，而不是对部件截图，因此保存的内容就是屏幕上显示的内容，并且具有完整的矢量质量。

records.context: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.translation: **样式是一个值。** 控件写入 :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` 并请求重绘。这使整个外观可以保存为 JSON、重新加载并加以复现。

records.context: **Clicking is a lookup, not a hit test on pixels.** The nearest point is found in data space normalised by the axis ranges, so a click is as accurate on a squashed axis as on a square one.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.context: Normalising by each axis's visible range is what makes a click land on the point that looks closest. Raw Euclidean distance in data units picks the wrong point whenever the axes have different scales, which on a volcano they always do.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer.VolcanoExplorer.nearest_point#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Normalising by each axis's visible range is what makes a click land on the point that looks closest. Raw Euclidean distance in data units picks the wrong point whenever the axes have different scales, which on a volcano they always do.
records.translation: 按每个坐标轴的可见范围归一化，才能让点击落在看起来最近的点上。只要两个坐标轴的尺度不同，以数据单位计算的原始欧几里得距离就会选错点，而火山图的坐标轴总是尺度不同。

records.context: A bad setting does not remove the plot. Rather than replacing the whole volcano with "cannot draw this plot" over one mistyped field, the offending settings fall back to the last value that drew, the figure stays up, the name of each offending setting goes red and the reasons are printed under the plot.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer.VolcanoExplorer.refresh#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A bad setting does not remove the plot. Rather than replacing the whole volcano with "cannot draw this plot" over one mistyped field, the offending settings fall back to the last value that drew, the figure stays up, the name of each offending setting goes red and the reasons are printed under the plot.
records.translation: 一个错误的设置不会导致图消失。不会因为一个输错的字段就把整个火山图替换为 "cannot draw this plot"（无法绘制此图），而是让出问题的设置回退到上一次能够绘制的值，图形保持显示，每个出问题设置的名称变为红色，并在图下方列出原因。

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``screen=True``: this render is being read, so it takes :attr:`VolcanoStyle.screen_background`. The export path does not pass it and therefore keeps the transparent figure default.
records.translation: ``screen=True``：这次渲染是供阅读的，因此采用 :attr:`VolcanoStyle.screen_background`。导出路径不传入此参数，因此保持图形默认的透明背景。
